name: team_planning_clear_change
description: Stop a scenario of a Team Planning plan overriding one facet of one subject, so it follows its parent there again: the 'follow reality' answer when reconciling. facet is as team_planning_overrides lists it, such as 'rule:<name>'. The earlier change stays in the plan's history. Refused if the scenario doesn't change that facet, or unless the caller is an editor. Without the see-pay right, a budget line that carries an amount is refused too.
